package_purpose: Machine-readable index tying together the master corpora, curated daily pool, and all registries WITHOUT duplicating large canonical text bodies.
top_level_honesty_statement: Every 'verified' claim in this package means: this pipeline's data was programmatically compared, full-corpus or by reproducible random sample, against a named open-source upstream dataset, and matched. It is NOT a claim of independent Islamic scholarly authentication. Hadith grading reflects named scholars cited in the source datasets, never an isnad/matn judgment made by this pipeline. Editorial/curation labels (excellent/good/conditional/not_suitable) are AI-assisted heuristic judgments for notification-suitability only, not religious rulings.
